name: inline-css-to-style
description: Extract inline CSS to a top/head style tag, adjacent CSS file, or clipboard with smart selector inference.

inlineCssToStyle.mode.description: Smart: extract shared properties to the broadest safe selector, preferring ID over class over tag for equal matches; also analyze ancestor/child relationships. Simple: always generate classes.

enumDescriptions: Create a new <style> at the start of an existing <head>. If there is no <head>, insert it at the top of the file, after DOCTYPE if present.
Append to a usable <style> inside <head>, or insert a new one there. If there is no <head>, use the top of the document.
Create an adjacent .extracted.css file and insert a <link rel="stylesheet"> inside <head> or at the top if no head exists.
Copy extracted CSS declarations to the clipboard; update HTML references but do not insert CSS.
Copy extracted CSS wrapped in a <style> element; update HTML references but do not insert CSS.
inlineCssToStyle.destination.description: Where the extracted CSS goes. Default: at the start of <head>, or the beginning of the file if <head> is absent.
